description: The boards’ own calls, locked at the 6 Oct 2026 close with a SHA-256 receipt and scored against what happened: places for cash for 1, 3 and 6 months (paid what it said, no loss), cash cows and cash machines (beat the S&P 500 fund on total return, same dates), and Edgarette’s 12-month expected-return calls (landed inside her 80% range). A test of the boards, not advice.
name: get_board_test
